description: Source code implementing ASN1_TYPE handling functions for ASN.1 data structures in OpenSSL's BoringSSL library.

methods.name: ASN1_TYPE_get
methods.description: Returns the type of ASN1_TYPE or 0 if value is NULL.

methods.name: asn1_type_value_as_pointer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the ASN1_TYPE value based on its type.

methods.name: asn1_type_cleanup
methods.description: Frees or resets the ASN1_TYPE value based on its type.

methods.name: ASN1_TYPE_set
methods.description: Sets the ASN1_TYPE with a specified type and value, cleaning up previous data.

methods.name: ASN1_TYPE_set1
methods.description: Sets the ASN1_TYPE with a copy of the provided value, handling duplication.

methods.name: ASN1_TYPE_cmp
methods.description: Compares two ASN1_TYPE objects for equality.
